preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in query_cities)
preconditions.description: Each city in the queries is within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in merge_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each pair of cities in the merge queries is within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) and answer >= 0 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer to a query of the first type is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(answer <= n - 1 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer to a query of the first type is at most n-1.
